correctness.rationale: The exact polynomial identities and exhaustive finite-field checks were reproduced using the packaged verifier. The smoothness and transversality arguments prove reduced fibers away from 2,3, and the characteristic-three triple Cartier divisor. In characteristic two, Frobenius fourth powers and transverse line factors yield three complete local algebras k[[u,v]]/(u^4,v^4). Each projective geometric fiber is a proper (4,12) intersection of length 48; projective quasi-finiteness plus constant length over each DVR proves finite flatness. The finite script does not replace the proof of universal characteristic exclusion.
